b1-39.title: At the university
b1-39.story: Anna studies at a technical [[institute]] in Kyiv. On Monday, her [[professor]] talked about the new [[curriculum]] for next year. Students can also take an [[online course]] in English from home. Max wants to get a [[grant]] to study in Canada next summer. He needs a good [[argument]] for why he should get it. Anna found some great facts in an old [[encyclopedia]] at the library. She wrote the main ideas on the board with a green [[marker]]. Max read them and smiled. "Now my letter is ready!" he said.

b1-40.title: Measuring things
b1-40.story: Anna and her dad are making a round table for the garden. "The [[diameter]] should be one hundred and twenty [[centimeters|centimeter]]," Dad says. To find the area, Anna needs the [[formula]] for a circle. Taras brings her an old [[calculator]], but it doesn't work. So she uses an [[online calculator]] on her phone. Then Dad drives to the store to buy some paint. One [[gallon]] of paint is enough for the whole table. In the evening, the family eats dinner at their new table.

b1-41.title: A day at the zoo
b1-41.story: On Saturday, Anna took her little brother Taras to the city zoo. First, they watched a big [[gorilla]] eating leaves in the shade. Next, they saw a black and white [[panda]] sleeping in a tree. Taras loved the pink [[flamingo]] standing on one leg in the water. A sign said the zoo copies each animal's natural [[habitat]]. In the farm area, a gray [[mule]] was carrying bags of food. Suddenly, a [[raccoon]] ran across the path with a stolen sandwich! "What a clever little [[organism]]," Anna laughed. Taras said the raccoon was his favorite animal of the day.

b1-42.title: Summer on the farm
b1-42.story: In July, Anna and Taras spent two weeks at their grandparents' farm. Every morning, Grandpa drove his old [[tractor]] across the field. Taras wore a big hat and called himself a [[cowboy]]. Bees flew from flower to flower, collecting [[nectar]] for honey. In the afternoon, the kids took a small boat along the [[canal]] near the village. Their clothes got very dirty, so Grandma washed them on the short [[cycle]]. That evening, everyone ate fresh honey and bread outside. "This farm is a real [[paradise]]," Anna said with a smile.

b1-43.title: Our changing climate
b1-43.story: Anna's class is doing a project about the [[climate]] in their [[region]]. Anna's grandpa says every [[season]] is hotter and drier than before. Last year, a [[tornado]] even damaged a farm near his village. Lisa explains that cars put a dangerous [[pollutant]] into the air. Trees take in carbon [[dioxide]], so they help keep the air clean. Ira has a simple idea: start a [[recycling]] program at school. For a week, the students collect every [[plastic]] bottle they can find. At the end, they have five full bags and a great project.

b1-44.title: In the science lab
b1-44.story: In the lab, Anna and Max did a fun [[experiment]] with a strong [[magnet]]. First, they tested every metal [[object]] on the table. Then their teacher showed them a small [[fragment]] of a dark rock. "This [[mineral]] has iron in it, so the magnet likes it," she explained. Next, they watched a video about an [[electron]] moving around an atom. Max asked why we need [[oxygen]] so much. "Your heart is an [[organ]] that needs it every second," the teacher said. "Teamwork is also an important [[element]] of science," she added. "I'm bad at science, so maybe it's in my [[genes|gene]]," Max joked. "No, you just need more practice!" Anna laughed.

b1-45.title: Election in town
b1-45.story: Anna's town is choosing a new [[mayor]] this month. At school, Max is running for student [[president]], and Anna is his [[vice president]]. One town candidate calls himself a proud [[nationalist]] and gives loud speeches. On Friday, some students held a small [[protest]] against closing the old park. A local [[journalist]] came to ask them questions. Later, a [[columnist]] in the newspaper wrote that the park plan was complete [[nonsense]]. In the end, the town found a [[compromise]]: half of the park will stay. Max and Anna also had a bake sale for a children's [[charity]]. They didn't win the school election, but they were proud of their work.

b1-46.title: A detective movie night
b1-46.story: On Friday night, Anna and Max watched an old [[detective]] movie at home. In the film, a quiet [[sheriff]] lives in a small town by the sea. One stormy night, a ship sends an [[SOS]] near the town. People think a [[terrorist]] attacked the ship, and the TV news talks about [[terrorism]]. The army even sends a [[tank]] to the town. But the sheriff just asks, "Where is your [[proof]]?" He finds out that the ship's engine simply broke down. At the end, Max noticed the [[copyright]] date on the screen: 1962. "This movie is older than Grandpa!" Anna laughed.
